Messages.Author: Ivan Lerth
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I've some questions I couldn´t find answers for in the rulings and
clarifications:

1. Who chooses the new acting vampire strike after using 'Primal
Instincts', the controller of the opposing vampire or the one who
played PI? (Card text: (S) Cancel this <acting> vampire's strike and
choose a new one)

2. This is a situation that happened on a game: A vampire with Superior
Protean didn´t have any blood counter left at the beggining of his
controller turn so it had to hunt, but it was intercepted. The combat
starts but this hungry vampire uses Earth Melt at Sup. then the combat
ends and untaps... according to the rules of S:CE he can´t hunt again,
but here´s the question: can he do OTHER action even when he has not
any blood left? (i.e. bleeding, political action).

Thanks a lot,
I. Lerth

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ivan Lerth wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> I've some questions I couldn´t find answers for in the rulings and
> clarifications:
>
> 1. Who chooses the new acting vampire strike after using 'Primal
> Instincts', the controller of the opposing vampire or the one who
> played PI? (Card text: (S) Cancel this <acting> vampire's strike and
> choose a new one)

The one who played PI (the controller of the vampire who played PI).

> 2. This is a situation that happened on a game: A vampire with Superior
> Protean didn´t have any blood counter left at the beggining of his
> controller turn so it had to hunt, but it was intercepted. The combat
> starts but this hungry vampire uses Earth Melt at Sup. then the combat
> ends and untaps... according to the rules of S:CE he can´t hunt again,
> but here´s the question: can he do OTHER action even when he has not
> any blood left? (i.e. bleeding, political action).

No. The only action a ready, empty, untapped vampire can take is: hunt.
If he is prohibited from hunting, he can take no actions.

Messages.Author: david hathorn
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 11 Oct 1999, LSJ wrote:

> No. The only action a ready, empty, untapped vampire can take is:
> hunt. If he is prohibited from hunting, he can take no actions.

?!? Where is this rule? In the revised rulebook, under section 6.1.2
(hunting), it states [ _emphasis_ mine ] :

"Any time during a Methuselah's minion phase that one of her ready
untapped vampires is empty ( _and_ _not_ _otherwise_ _prohibited_ _from_
_hunting_ ), he must hunt immediately, before any other action is taken by
any minion."

So vampires who are a) empty and b) not prohibited from hunting must hunt.
But this doesn't say anything about empty vampires who *are* prohibited
from hunting (say, by the DCI no repeat action rule.)

Other areas of the rulebook and the rules outline state that only ready,
untapped minions can perform actions, but there doesn't seem to be
anything about empty vampires only being able to hunt.

In the rulings, there is nothing about this under "Vampires," "Hunting,"
or "Actions."

So, where's this rule anyway?

-davey!

> "Any time during a Methuselah's minion phase that one of her ready

> _hunting_ ), he must hunt immediately, before any other action is taken by

>
> So vampires who are a) empty and b) not prohibited from hunting must hunt.
> But this doesn't say anything about empty vampires who *are* prohibited
> from hunting (say, by the DCI no repeat action rule.)

Right. The idea is hinted at by the use of parentheses (that is: without
the parentheses, a problem arises). The rule itself is too much of a
"corner case" to be explictly recorded in the rules.

> Other areas of the rulebook and the rules outline state that only ready,
> untapped minions can perform actions, but there doesn't seem to be
> anything about empty vampires only being able to hunt.
>
> In the rulings, there is nothing about this under "Vampires," "Hunting,"
> or "Actions."

Hmm. It used to be. But you're right: it's not there now. I'll
remedy that in the next update.

Thanks.
